changes: Mandate anchoring to EVT-2 occurrences and inventory authority via SEAT-1.
Mandate ORD-1 breadcrumbs and bundle apportionment/rounding strategy.
change_log.summary: Initial OFFER-1 commercial grammar contract (Offer/ProductRevision/OfferWindow/Eligibility claims) anchored to EVT-2 and SEAT-1 with strict tax/currency and apportionment laws.
Add organizer setup lifecycle and bind reusable ProductRevision configuration to PRICE-1 PricingProgramRevision.
Correct T0 lifecycle, quote binding, inventory proof, or publication semantics; align release identity metadata.
Complete ProductRevision input authority, quote lifecycle guards, and action dependency floors.

changes: Require explicit quote idempotency key and map the complete PRICE-1 snapshot input; raise ORD-1 floor to 3.8.3 and declare the OFFER-to-ORD snapshot handoff.
Correct the P0 gate contract-version identity assertion to match this release.

resources.name: Offer
resources.purpose: Storefront wrapper that groups Products for a defined occurrence scope.

resources.name: Product
resources.purpose: Stable identity for something that can be sold (revisions are immutable).

resources.name: ProductRevision
resources.purpose: Immutable sellable unit. Defines entitlements, inventory claims, reusable PRICE-1 program-revision binding, and rounding strategy.

resources.name: OfferWindow
resources.purpose: Commercial phase/timebox. Carries eligibility + pricing overrides and may reference prerequisite requirements.

resources.name: SignedEligibilityClaim
resources.purpose: Portable commercial eligibility claim envelope (Ed25519) bound to org_id and offer_window_id.

required_attributes.description: Stable grant identifier (UUIDv7) for the entitlement being exercised.
required_attributes.name: entitlement_grant_id

required_attributes.description: One-time random nonce to prevent replay of a signed claim.
required_attributes.name: consumption_nonce

eligibility_policy_spec.notes: When mode==signed_claim_required, SignedEligibilityClaim must validate against EligibilityIssuerKey registry.

entitlement_spec.notes: buffer_minutes is critical for session windows (morning/afternoon/full-day) to prevent shadow manual overrides.

invariants: If claim_type == seat_ids then seat_ids MUST be present and bucket_id/quantity MUST be null.
If claim_type == bucket_quantity then bucket_id and quantity MUST be present and seat_ids MUST be null.
If claim_type == unbounded then seat_ids/bucket_id/quantity MUST be null.

occurrence_scope_spec.notes: Offer scopes must anchor to EVT-2 occurrence(s). Parent occurrence may be used for festival/day containers.

prerequisite_policy_spec.notes: Prerequisite enforcement for add-ons/session products. When mode==requires_entitlement, proof must be provided via SignedEligibilityClaim bound to the OfferWindow.

pricing_override_spec.notes: Percentages are UI-only; PRICE-1 snapshots and minor-unit values are authoritative at sale time.

uuid_v4.description: RFC 4122 UUID version 4 (random). Used only for non-ordered nonces (never for ordering).

InventoryBucket/Seat holds and allocations are authoritative inventory claims.
PRICE-SIG-V4 quote snapshot creation, activation, and transaction-specific pricing authority.
Single tax context per order; credit-note legality relies on tax context.

Voucher/admission scan policies referenced by entitlement specs.
Actor identifiers and org tenancy are defined here.

build_cart_quote.must: MUST fail-closed if TAXCTX-V2 values cannot unify across all revisions in cart or if currency codes differ.
build_cart_quote.purpose: Authorize offer.quote.create for OFFER-1.build_cart_quote. OFFER validates eligibility, ProductRevision, tax profile, pricing binding, and quote invariants, then invokes PRICE-1.create_snapshot and PRICE-1.activate_snapshot as subordinate governed actions.
validation_rules: ProductRevision MUST reference pricing_program_revision_id, not price_snapshot_id.
PRICE-1 PricingSnapshot MUST be transaction-specific, time-bounded, signed, and eligible for consumption by one Order only.
The quote MUST expose the exact pricing_snapshot_id and expiry used by ORD-1.
MUST fail-closed if TAXCTX-V2 values cannot unify across all revisions in cart or if currency codes differ.
PRICE-1 PricingSnapshot MUST have consumed_by_order_id null until ORD-1 binds the exact quote to one order; it MUST NOT be consumed by a different order.
Offer.status MUST equal active; draft or archived Offers MUST fail closed.
Product.status MUST equal active and Product.offer_id MUST equal the Offer identified by the OfferWindow; draft or archived Products MUST fail closed.
ProductRevision MUST belong to the active Product and MUST be immutable and valid under its required-attribute and entitlement/inventory rules.
OfferWindow MUST belong to the active Offer and database UTC MUST satisfy starts_at_utc <= now < ends_at_utc.
Every referenced EVT-2 Occurrence MUST pass current EVT-2 buyer sale eligibility at database quote time.
The referenced PRICE-1 PricingProgramRevision MUST be active and eligible at quote time under PRICE-1 program-selection rules.
Offer, Product, ProductRevision, OfferWindow, EVT-2 Occurrences, and PRICE-1 Program/PricingProgramRevision MUST match the same org_id and declared event/occurrence scope.
If any quote precondition fails, return ERR_PRECONDITION and create neither a buyer quote nor a PRICE-1 snapshot.
inputs.idempotency_key MUST be required, non-empty, and passed unchanged as PRICE-1.create_snapshot.idempotency_key; OFFER MUST NOT derive or replace idempotency_key.
OFFER MUST supply every required PRICE-1.create_snapshot input according to price_snapshot_input_mapping; a quote MUST represent one event and one PRICE-1-compatible pricing revision or fail closed.
For the same (org_id, operation_id, key) and identical canonical request_hash, return the same quote_id and pricing_snapshot_id for the existing snapshot. Do not create a duplicate snapshot.
For the same (org_id, operation_id, key) with different canonical request_hash, fail with ERR_CONFLICT / EXT_IDEMPOTENCY_REPLAY and create no replacement snapshot.
The output quote_id MUST equal pricing_snapshot_id, matching PRICE-1 quote_id=snapshot_id alias authority.
ProductRevision MUST pin immutable tax_profile_id; it MUST NOT pin a transaction TaxContext identity.

Resolve one deterministic immutable TAXCTX-V2 value at quote time using the exact pinned ProductRevision.tax_profile_id, authorized inclusion-mode mapping, evaluated_at_utc, and canonical digest mapping. For T0, the exact pinned TaxProfile MUST have default_tax_basis=org_location; TAX-1 MUST NOT persist a TaxContext resource; PII-1 owns direct jurisdiction evidence.
Buyer authorization is offer.quote.create for OFFER-1.build_cart_quote. PRICE-1 actions are subordinate governed actions and are not buyer-authorized endpoints.

Internal PRICE-1 invocation MUST use scoped authenticated delegation and preserve originating actor attribution, org_id, request_id, trace_id, and boundary Idempotency-Key. Generic bypass and authorize?: false are forbidden.
OFFER owns eligibility, ProductRevision, tax/pricing binding, and quote invariants. PRICE owns snapshot, signature, activation, and pricing invariants. OFFER MUST NOT write PRICE resources directly.

Platform-wide idempotency identity is (org_id, operation_id, key), with a separate SHA-256 over normalized effect-determining input. Identical input replays the original outcome; changed input returns ERR_CONFLICT / EXT_IDEMPOTENCY_REPLAY; concurrent requests replay the original outcome.
OFFER MUST supply all locked snapshot signature references and TAXCTX-V2 fields through the scoped delegated PRICE-1.create_snapshot action.
T0 MUST require public eligibility and MUST fail closed when an EligibilityIssuerKey, SignedEligibilityClaim, or claim nonce is needed.
Each ProductRevision tax_profile_id MUST resolve to its exact pinned TaxProfile, which MUST be active and usable for selling at quote time; TAX-1 MUST NOT substitute another profile.

For each ProductRevision being resolved, OFFER MUST pass that exact ProductRevision.tax_profile_id as resolve_tax_context_for_event.tax_profile_id. TAX-1 MUST resolve the same tenant-owned, active profile and MUST NOT substitute another profile.

T0 MUST require default_tax_basis=org_location on the exact ProductRevision-pinned TaxProfile. event_location and customer_location are unsupported and MUST fail with ERR_PRECONDITION / TAX_JURISDICTION_REQUIRED before PRICE-1.create_snapshot or activation; OFFER MUST NOT infer a Jurisdiction from EVT-2 Occurrence.venue.

For T0 quotes, the resolved rounding_mode MUST equal half_even_minor_units. If TAX returns another generally allowed mode, OFFER MUST fail closed before PRICE-1.create_snapshot. This T0 restriction does not narrow general TAX-1 rounding modes.
For every T0 quote, applicable_tax_rate_revision_refs MUST equal a one-element list containing the exact TAX-1 tax_rate_id returned for the resolved single TAXCTX-V2 context.

For every T0 org_location quote, opaque_pii_jurisdiction_evidence_ref and jurisdiction_evidence_sha256 MUST be explicit null values. PRICE-1 MUST preserve and sign both explicit nulls; TAXCTX-V2 continues to bind the resolved org jurisdiction and tax basis.

quote_preconditions.occurrence_eligibility: Every referenced EVT-2 occurrence MUST pass current buyer sale eligibility, including parent Event publication, occurrence state, UTC sale window, and sovereignty checks.
quote_preconditions.pricing_program_revision: The exact referenced PRICE-1 PricingProgramRevision MUST be active and eligible at database quote time under PRICE-1 program selection rules.
quote_preconditions.tenant_binding: Offer, Product, ProductRevision, OfferWindow, all EVT-2 occurrences, and PRICE-1 program/revision MUST share the same org_id supplied as inputs.org_id and matching foreign-key/event scope.

price_snapshot_lifecycle.ownership_rule: OFFER-1 MUST invoke PRICE-1 actions; it MUST NOT write PRICE-1 resource fields directly.

price_snapshot_input_mapping.currency: single resolved currency_code shared by all requested line_quotes
price_snapshot_input_mapping.expires_at_utc: PRICE-1 quote TTL policy using database time, bounded by the active OfferWindow end and PRICE-1 maximum
price_snapshot_input_mapping.price_lines: resolved, signed price lines derived from requested_items and the active PricingProgramRevision/phase
price_snapshot_input_mapping.event_id: the one event_id shared by all requested occurrence references; reject mixed-event quotes
price_snapshot_input_mapping.occurrence_ids: sorted unique occurrence IDs resolved from requested_items and verified against EVT-2
price_snapshot_input_mapping.pricing_program_revision_id: the exact active pricing_program_revision_id referenced by each requested ProductRevision; reject a mixed-revision quote if PRICE-1 cannot represent it
price_snapshot_input_mapping.pricing_phase_id: the active phase selected by PRICE-1 for the referenced PricingProgramRevision
price_snapshot_input_mapping.pricing_experiment_id: selected PRICE-1 experiment ID, or null when no experiment applies
price_snapshot_input_mapping.pricing_variant_key: selected PRICE-1 variant key, or null when no experiment applies
price_snapshot_input_mapping.product_revision_ids: sorted unique immutable ProductRevision IDs represented by price_lines
price_snapshot_input_mapping.tax_pricing_mode: Map the resolved TAXCTX-V2 inclusion_mode using PRICE-1 authority: inclusive -> inclusive; exclusive -> exclusive_add_on.
price_snapshot_input_mapping.originating_actor_id: original buyer actor id preserved through scoped authenticated delegation
price_snapshot_input_mapping.request_id: boundary request id preserved through scoped authenticated delegation
price_snapshot_input_mapping.trace_id: boundary trace id preserved through scoped authenticated delegation
price_snapshot_input_mapping.tax_profile_id: same-named field from the resolved immutable TAXCTX-V2 quote value
price_snapshot_input_mapping.applicable_tax_rate_revision_refs: [the one resolved TAX-1 tax_rate_id] for the single T0 TAXCTX-V2 context
price_snapshot_input_mapping.evaluated_at_utc: same-named field from the resolved immutable TAXCTX-V2 quote value
price_snapshot_input_mapping.digest_version: same-named field from the resolved immutable TAXCTX-V2 quote value
price_snapshot_input_mapping.digest_sha256: same-named field from the resolved immutable TAXCTX-V2 quote value

idempotency_semantics.identity: (org_id, operation_id, key), durably enforced through LOCKS-1 idempotency storage
idempotency_semantics.durable_storage_field_mapping: LOCKS-1 field operation_id stores the stable operation_id value; uniqueness is (org_id, operation_id, key).
idempotency_semantics.key: Boundary Idempotency-Key, forwarded unchanged to PRICE-1.create_snapshot and activate_snapshot.
idempotency_semantics.request_hash: Separate SHA-256 over the canonical normalized effect-determining OFFER request, stored separately from the key identity.
idempotency_semantics.replay: Same identity and request_hash return the original quote outcome. Concurrent requests wait for and replay that outcome.
idempotency_semantics.mismatch: Same identity with a different request_hash returns ERR_CONFLICT / EXT_IDEMPOTENCY_REPLAY without repeating side effects.

delegation_context.price_request_hash: PRICE-1 durably stores a separate SHA-256 request_hash for normalized effect-determining create_snapshot input through LOCKS-1 idempotency storage.
delegation_context.boundary_idempotency_key: inputs.idempotency_key is the boundary Idempotency-Key and is forwarded unchanged

tax_context_resolution_input_mapping.tax_profile_id: The exact immutable ProductRevision.tax_profile_id; no profile substitution.
tax_context_resolution_input_mapping.event_jurisdiction_hint: null for T0 org_location quotes; do not project EVT-2 Occurrence.venue

tax_context_t0_lock.scope: T0 quote creation through persisted draft Order only
tax_context_t0_lock.unsupported_basis_behavior: Fail with ERR_PRECONDITION / TAX_JURISDICTION_REQUIRED before PRICE-1.create_snapshot or PricingSnapshot activation; create no quote or snapshot.
tax_context_t0_lock.rate_reference_mapping: Set applicable_tax_rate_revision_refs to a one-element list containing the exact TAX-1 tax_rate_id returned for the single resolved T0 TAXCTX-V2 context.
tax_context_t0_lock.scope_boundary: This T0 quote posture does not change TAX finalization or paid-Order evidence requirements.
tax_context_t0_lock.jurisdiction_resolution_rule: Resolve the exact pinned profile using TAX-1 org_location semantics. If TAX-1 cannot satisfy that configured basis, fail with ERR_PRECONDITION / TAX_JURISDICTION_REQUIRED before PRICE-1.create_snapshot; do not derive jurisdiction from Occurrence.venue.

emit_ord_line_items.must: MUST include mandatory breadcrumbs and persisted apportionment priority map snapshot.
emit_ord_line_items.purpose: Emit canonical ORD-1 line items from an accepted quote and sale snapshot.
validation_rules: Line items MUST be derived from the accepted quote and exact pricing_snapshot_id.
Line items MUST bind each inventory claim to its verified occurrence, inventory type, bucket or seat references, and quantity.
MUST include mandatory breadcrumbs and persisted apportionment priority map snapshot.

create_offer.purpose: Create an Offer in draft state for organizer-managed occurrences.
validation_rules: Actor MUST be authenticated and authorized to manage org_id.
Every occurrence in occurrence_scope MUST exist in EVT-2 and belong to org_id.
status MUST be initialized as draft.
archived_at_utc MUST be initialized to null.

create_product.purpose: Create a Product in draft state under an authorized same-tenant Offer.
validation_rules: Offer MUST exist in org_id and MUST NOT be archived.
Actor MUST be authenticated and authorized to manage org_id.
status MUST be initialized as draft.
archived_at_utc MUST be initialized to null.

create_product_revision.purpose: Create an immutable ProductRevision using reusable PRICE-1 pricing configuration.
validation_rules: Product MUST exist in org_id and MUST NOT be archived.
Every anchor occurrence MUST exist in EVT-2 within org_id.
PricingProgramRevision MUST exist in PRICE-1 within org_id, belong to the same event scope, and be eligible for quote resolution.
Do not accept or persist a PricingSnapshot id as reusable configuration.
Revision sequence MUST be the next monotonic sequence for the Product.
Every required ProductRevision attribute MUST be supplied by an explicit action input or by the documented server/database derivation in persisted_attribute_sources.
is_bundle=false requires bundle_apportionment_map=null. The action MUST NOT infer a bundle map or default a missing is_bundle value.
rounding_strategy MUST be supplied explicitly and MUST be an allowed rounding_strategy_enum value.
primary_entitlement_id MUST be supplied explicitly as a UUID or null; if non-null it MUST identify exactly one entitlement_specs.entitlement_id. The action MUST NOT infer a primary entitlement.
If is_bundle=true, bundle_apportionment_map MUST satisfy OFFER-1-INV-BUNDLE-APPORTION-001.
T0 MUST reject any anchor Occurrence with EVT-2 depth_level=1 or parent_occurrence_id present.
TaxProfile MUST exist and belong to inputs.org_id; creation does not require the profile to be active.

persisted_attribute_sources.revision_seq: inputs.revision_seq, validated as the next monotonic Product sequence
persisted_attribute_sources.bundle_apportionment_map: inputs.bundle_apportionment_map, including explicit null for a non-bundle
persisted_attribute_sources.primary_entitlement_id: inputs.primary_entitlement_id, including explicit null when no primary entitlement is designated

create_offer_window.purpose: Create an OfferWindow for an existing same-tenant Offer.
validation_rules: Offer MUST exist in org_id and MUST NOT be archived.
starts_at_utc MUST be earlier than ends_at_utc.
Any occurrence scope and pricing override MUST resolve within org_id.
Actor MUST be authenticated and authorized to manage org_id.
T0 MUST accept only eligibility_policy.mode=public and prerequisite_policy.mode=none or null; signed_claim_required and requires_entitlement are unsupported.

activate_offer.purpose: Activate a draft Offer for organizer sale.
validation_rules: Current status MUST be draft.
At least one same-tenant Product in draft with an immutable valid revision and valid OfferWindow MUST be configured in the Offer occurrence scope. Product activation follows Offer activation.
All referenced EVT-2 occurrences MUST be valid and not archived/cancelled.
Actor MUST be authorized for org_id.
archived_at_utc MUST remain null while status is active.

activate_product.purpose: Activate a draft Product after validating its offer and revision.
validation_rules: Current status MUST be draft.
Parent Offer MUST be active in the same org_id.
At least one immutable ProductRevision MUST have valid occurrence anchors, a reusable PRICE-1 PricingProgramRevision, currency and tax context.
Actor MUST be authorized for org_id.
archived_at_utc MUST remain null while status is active.

archive_offer.purpose: Archive an Offer without deleting its commercial history.
validation_rules: Current status MUST be draft or active.
Actor MUST be authorized for org_id.
Archived Offer MUST not become active again.
Set archived_at_utc from the database clock in the same transaction as status=archived; return the persisted value.

state_transition.side_effects: Persist status=archived and archived_at_utc=database_now atomically; preserve all history.

archive_product.purpose: Archive a Product without deleting its revision history.
validation_rules: Current status MUST be draft or active.
Actor MUST be authorized for org_id.
Archived Product MUST not become active again.
Set archived_at_utc from the database clock in the same transaction as status=archived; return the persisted value.

state_transition.side_effects: Persist status=archived and archived_at_utc=database_now atomically; preserve all history.

invariants.must: Every ProductRevision.anchor_occurrence_ids MUST reference existing EVT-2 Occurrence records within the same org_id. Orphan products are forbidden.
A single order/cart MUST resolve to exactly one deterministic immutable TAXCTX-V2 value. If contexts implied by the requested items cannot unify, the system MUST fail closed and refuse checkout.
All ProductRevisions in a cart/bundle MUST share the same PRICE-1 currency_code. Mixed-currency carts/bundles MUST be rejected (fail-closed).

If ProductRevision.is_bundle == true, bundle_apportionment_map MUST be present and MUST include every entitlement_spec component with fixed_amount_minor units summing exactly to the ProductRevision total price in minor units.

Rounding remainder rule: when a total price is allocated across components, the component with the highest apportionment_priority MUST absorb any ±1 minor-unit remainder so ORD-1 and LED-1 reconcile exactly.

Every ORD-1 line item emitted for an OFFER-1 sale MUST include offer_id and product_revision_id, and MUST include inventory_bucket_id when the revision contains a bucket claim. These breadcrumbs are mandatory for refunds, audits, and scan policy enforcement.

In any bundle apportionment, if multiple entitlements share the same apportionment_priority, the designated lead MUST be the lexicographically smallest entitlement_spec_id using memcmp semantics on the raw UUID bytes. This lead MUST absorb any ±1 minor-unit rounding remainder.
Outside T0, if a ProductRevision anchors to a child Occurrence, the selling OfferWindow MUST require prerequisite proof via SignedEligibilityClaim. T0 MUST reject child Occurrences.

invariants.rule: Outside T0, SignedEligibilityClaim signatures include entitlement_grant_id and consumption_nonce, and SUB-1 enforces single-use consumption at Order Finalization. T0 MUST NOT create, validate, or consume these claims or nonces.

invariants.must: ProductRevision pricing configuration MUST be reusable and MUST reference PricingProgramRevision. A buyer quote MUST cause OFFER-1 to invoke PRICE-1.create_snapshot and PRICE-1.activate_snapshot for a transaction-specific, signed, time-bounded PricingSnapshot. ORD-1 consumes that exact snapshot only through PRICE-1.consume_snapshot.

invariants.text: OFFER returns the exact active transaction-specific PRICE-1 quote snapshot. Its ORD-1 checkout handoff MUST pass that id unchanged as pricing_snapshot_id; ORD persists it only as Order.price_snapshot_id and consumes it through PRICE-1.consume_snapshot.

must_not_do: MUST NOT define seat-map or capacity physics (SEAT-1 is sole inventory authority).
MUST NOT define event reality semantics beyond anchoring to EVT-2 occurrences.
MUST NOT embed general eCommerce catalog (no COM-1); every sellable item anchors to an EVT-2 occurrence (including store/season occurrences).
purpose_and_boundaries.purpose: Define the commercial grammar that binds EVT-2 reality anchors to SEAT-1 inventory claims, PRICE-1 snapshots, TAX-1 context, eligibility claims, and entitlement fulfilment channels.

rules.text: Outside the T0 authority set, eligibility MAY use SignedEligibilityClaim (Ed25519). T0 MUST use public eligibility and MUST NOT validate or consume SignedEligibilityClaim.
Outside the T0 authority set, prerequisites for child/session products MUST validate current cart contents and historical entitlements. T0 does not support child occurrences or prerequisite claims.

ORD-1 line items produced from OFFER-1 MUST include offer_id and product_revision_id. If inventory claims include SEAT-1 bucket claims, the line MUST also include inventory_bucket_id and occurrence_id for traceability.

rules.must: ProductRevision MUST reference a reusable PRICE-1 PricingProgramRevision through pricing_program_revision_id. It MUST NOT persist a PricingSnapshot id. A buyer quote MUST resolve pricing from that program revision and create or bind a transaction-specific active PricingSnapshot with quote expiry and single-order consumed_by_order_id semantics. ORD-1.create_checkout MUST bind and consume that exact snapshot for at most one Order.

T0 MUST NOT create, rotate, or revoke EligibilityIssuerKey; create, revoke, validate, or consume SignedEligibilityClaim; or consume a claim nonce. T0 create_offer_window MUST accept only eligibility_policy.mode=public and prerequisite_policy.mode=none or null. T0 create_product_revision MUST reject child Occurrences (EVT-2 depth_level=1 or parent_occurrence_id present), and T0 build_cart_quote MUST fail closed if a claim or prerequisite proof is required. No T0 quote or setup action depends on this path.

tenancy.notes: All resources are tenant-scoped by org_id (uuid_v7).

OFFER-1-VEC-APPORTIONMENT-001.notes: When priorities tie, lead is lexicographically smallest entitlement_spec_id by raw UUID bytes (memcmp). Lead absorbs remainder (+1 minor here).
OFFER-1-VEC-APPORTIONMENT-001.title: Bundle apportionment remainder tie-breaker (memcmp UUID bytes)

transitions.side_effects: Persist draft state, archived_at_utc=null, and database timestamps.
Persist active state and transition timestamp; archived_at_utc remains null.
Persist archived status and archived_at_utc from database time; preserve history.
Persist draft state, archived_at_utc=null, and database timestamps.

guards: valid immutable revision and pricing configuration
transitions.side_effects: Persist active state and transition timestamp; archived_at_utc remains null.
Persist archived status and archived_at_utc from database time; preserve history.

states: immutable after create; time eligibility is evaluated at quote time

ord_checkout_binding.equality: Order.price_snapshot_id MUST equal the exact pricing_snapshot_id returned by the accepted OFFER quote.
ord_checkout_binding.lifecycle: OFFER creates and activates the transaction-specific PRICE-1 snapshot. ORD verifies the exact active, unexpired snapshot and invokes PRICE-1.consume_snapshot for its Order.
